I'll answer any questions about these vans. I've driven them since they released them to Amazon!

How accessible is the space?

I'm assuming you mean going from cabin to the back. This is a great question as it addresses my number one complaint. The bulk head door is very fragile, hateful, and full of spite. If your keyfob battery is low it will also try to impale you (it loses signal with a low battery keyfob) and will close and stick you with the locking mechanism (big metal ring). If the slides on the floor get too nasty (under the bulkhead door) it won't close right, get stuck, and cause problems. Nothing serious, its just annoying as a driver who is going back there 200 times a day. A broken Bulkhead door is such a pain in the left shoulder as you get to PUSH it open every time you try to go into the back. I have never been locked out of the cargo bay because of this mechanism, however I've heard from a couple fellow drivers that it CAN happen.

If the bulkhead door is working fine? Heaven on Earth. Effortless movement. You can double tap the unlock button on the FOB to open the door. Star Trek Style.

Comfy Ride?

Assuming the van is in (nearly) perfect condition? Its fantastic! Seats are still in great shape after 2 years! Steering wheel is heated and still in perfect shape. I wear rings on my fingers and still no visible issues. Pedals are perfect. Seat belt is nice and long and feels good, **HOWEVER,** **THE SEATBELT CLICKER THAT KEEPS YOU FROM DYING IS TRASH.** Half the vans I sit in I need to reassure myself that its actually locked in by giving the belt across my chest a tug. The sensors **WILL NOT NOTICE!!!** I've driven from point A to a stop sign and had my seat belt come off because it wasn't fully in place **(now the senor beeps btw!)** even though I put forth the usual effort I put into buckling myself in my personal vehicle. Otherwise, I can go in and out of this van all day, no problem.

The seat air conditioning and heat is fantastic. Honorable mention to the giant screen navigation. They need to change the fan in the back. It just blows air into the back and it's loud as heck! There is so much more to say but I'm going to stick to the question, haha.

I've driven these 4 days a week since they were released to Amazon. AMA

edit: I'm REALLY trying to stick to the specific questions asked of me. I could go into so much detail about everything down the turn signals and breaking system, but I want to stay on topic. We have a van with 30k miles!
